ideas.pitch: A computer-vision-guided payload dropping mechanism that mounts to standard UAV airframes for accurate target delivery.
ideas.title: AeroDrop: Precision Payload Release System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Mission Flight round requirements (payload drop task) with high mechanical precision and a live camera feedback demonstration.

ideas.pitch: An onboard edge-computing module that processes aerial video frames into a real-time stitched map without cloud dependency.
ideas.title: GeoMapper Edge: Offline Orthomosaic Stitching Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the mapping mission task entirely offline, leveraging hard engineering principles similar to edge-AI winners.

ideas.pitch: An independent hardware safety overlay that forces an immediate return-to-home or parachute deployment upon geofence breach or RC link loss.
ideas.title: SafeReturn: Geofence and Signal-Loss Fail-Safe Module
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with strict safety inspection rounds and rules, giving judges confidence in the team's risk management.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight secondary flight logger and telemetry broadcaster for crash analysis and compliance reporting.
ideas.title: AeroTelemetry: Long-Range Telemetry and Black Box Logger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aids the documentation and viva round by providing verifiable flight telemetry logs and crash-analysis data.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency, two-axis servo gimbal controlled by onboard color/object tracking to keep targets centered during flight.
ideas.title: VisionTrack: Autonomous Target Tracking Gimbal
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates an unusual physical build with a live working demo that stands out during flight evaluations.
